sanskrit:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ।।
image_english: Shutting out all external sense objects, keeping the eyes and vision concentrated between the two eyebrows...
caption:
Chapter 5, Verse 27

Kṛṣṇa introduces the physical yoga practice (Astanga/Dhyana) which will be detailed in the next chapter. ‘sparśān kṛtvā bahir bāhyāṁś’ (Shutting out all external sense objects). ‘cakṣuś caivāntare bhruvoḥ’ (Keeping the eyes and vision concentrated between the two eyebrows). ‘prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā’ (Suspending the inward and outward breaths). ‘nāsābhyantara-cāriṇau’ (Within the nostrils). This technique withdraws the mind from the external world to focus on the internal self.
